name: PromptChecker
description: Audit prompts (/prompt-check) across six lenses, converse with a prompt's persona (/prompt-chat) to author test anchors, and replay them as regression tests (/prompt-test). Anchors live in sidecar <prompt>.anchors.yaml files; flow anchors support multi-turn scripted conversations with silence handling and call closure. Cost-tuned via target_model / worker_model / judge_model split — frontier model only where it matters.
